caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a woman seated or positioned against a plain, light beige background. She has light-colored skin and grayish-blonde hair styled up and adorned with a black ribbon. The woman is wearing a voluminous black dress with detailed textures and ruffles, with the dress featuring a royal blue trim and gold edging. Green underlayers of the skirt are visible beneath the dress. Her bodice is decorated with a white area bordered in purple and green, and includes a large gold-colored cross pendant hanging from a pearl necklace. She wears additional beaded necklaces, earrings, and colorful accessories, including strings of blue, gold, and red beads draped across her dress and around her neck. There are also drop earrings with red details, and a black choker at the neck. Her facial features are sharply outlined, with blue eyes and red lips. The drawing is set in the center of a blank, undetailed background with no other objects present. The artist’s signature “L. Mülken” appears in the lower right corner.
title: China Headed Doll
